decisions.reason: The source decision retains automation for the LinkedIn outbound campaign; it does not resume or alter the deferred email campaign.
Continued use of MeetAlfred is consistent with the already-active configuration requirement and does not change its configuration or subscription attributes.
Retaining MeetAlfred automation for the outbound campaign does not change the HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred lead-transfer behavior.
The source does not address silent-lead follow-up workflows or resume this deferred requirement.
The decision to retain campaign automation through MeetAlfred does not specify any change to Zapier configuration, plan, or add-ons.
The source concerns whether the outbound campaign remains automated, not how new MeetAlfred campaigns are provisioned.
Keeping an outbound campaign automated through MeetAlfred does not modify the existing requirement to preserve the integration and existing campaigns.
The campaign automation policy does not affect which type of LinkedIn profile URL is stored in CRM.
The source does not change restrictions on using production MeetAlfred leads or identities for testing.
Automating an outbound campaign through MeetAlfred does not resolve or modify the deferred direct LinkedIn-to-HubSpot integration.
The source decision does not change the requirement to configure a LinkedIn lead list in Sales Navigator.
Retaining automation for the outbound campaign does not change the prohibition against sending old messages to recipients in the obsolete campaign list.
